{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA test orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.index[0]
best_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]

# Compute and print the number of refunded orders and valid orders
num_refunded = len(df[df['status'] == 'refunded'])
num_valid = len(df_filtered)

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Total revenue by channel:\n{total_revenue_by_channel}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}')
print(f'Number of valid orders (after filtering): {num_valid}')
print(f'Best channel: {best_channel}')
print(f'Best revenue: {best_revenue}')"}
